meta.note: Three-tile model. bodyPlan + signpostPlan per type. Single-direction types split their key pool into keyOpen (works as the FIRST body move) and keyMore (continuation phrases that imply a prior point), so line 1 always reads like an opening. for-against keeps its genuine for/for/against turn. · Oct 2026: bank phrases from data1/ vetted and promoted into the pools (converted to slot form); keys that repeated a signpost or an opinion verb, and so broke the signpost + view + key roll, were removed.
